name: LeapMemory
description:
LeapMemory gives Claude long-term memory. Facts you share are saved, distilled, and recalled in any future conversation, with each user's memory stored in its own isolated database. Everything is kept in your exact words, and nothing you save ever expires.

Memory briefing loads your background when a conversation starts, Memory recall finds relevant facts and their original wording, and Memory save keeps new facts as you share them. You can also set standing rules for how Claude works with you, and list or update them any time. Recall is free and unlimited. You can view and delete everything stored in the LeapMemory app at any time.

Works across chats: tell Claude something once, and it is known in every future conversation.

_published_faq.name: How do I add LeapMemory to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add LeapMemory to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.leapmemory.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the LeapMemory MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: LeapMemory provides these MCP tools: briefing, recall, remember, add_rule, list_rules, and update_rule.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to LeapMemory?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to LeapMemory in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
LeapMemory requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
LeapMemory is developed by Binary Leap. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
